⌈
Service Name
E2E_P06Forward (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P06Forward (
const E2E_P06ConfigType* ConfigPtr,
uint16 Length,
E2E_PCheckStatusType ForwardStatus,
E2E_P06ProtectStateType* StatePtr,
uint8* DataPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x35
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
ConfigPtr
Pointer to static configuration.
Length
Length of the data in bytes.
Parameters (in)
ForwardStatus
E2E Status of the received message
StatePtr
Pointer to port/data communication state.
